stem: A corrective-action record says only 'fixed' after repeated wet-floor events. Which additional evidence most strongly demonstrates real closure?
choices: The source of the leak was corrected, an owner and date were recorded, and follow-up inspection confirmed the condition did not recur
The floor was dry once at the end of the shift
Workers were reminded to be careful
rationale: Corrective action should preserve the cause/correction when known and include objective verification that the change worked rather than a vague closure statement.
